definition: Degree of foreign ownership, control, or influence over the supplier and its beneficial owners. Higher is worse; Green <= 30.
Exposure to covered/prohibited equipment (Section 889), SAM.gov exclusions/debarment, and OFAC-sanctioned parties. Higher is worse; Green <= 20.
Vendor cybersecurity posture: CMMC gap, reported incidents, and unremediated CVEs in supplied components. Higher is worse; Green <= 35.
Financial distress signals: credit downgrade, liquidity, going-concern doubt. Higher is worse; Green <= 40.
Schedule and delivery risk: on-time delivery shortfall and past-performance slippage. Higher is worse; Green <= 30.
Concentration risk from single/sole-source dependency and geographic clustering of supply. Higher is worse; Green <= 35.
Risk of counterfeit, gray-market, or unverifiable-provenance parts (missing SBOM / chain-of-custody). Higher is worse; Green <= 30.
